description: Query rows from an existing GA4 Audience Export. User/device identifiers are redacted by default; include them only through explicit opt-in.

audienceExportName.description: Full GA4 audience-export resource name returned by list_audience_exports.

includePersonalIdentifiers.description: Explicitly return user/device identifiers. False redacts identifier columns by default.

limit.description: Maximum number of returned items or rows. The declared bounds and default apply; use pagination for additional results.

offset.description: Zero-based number of rows to skip before returning results.

name: ga4_query_audience_export

result.description: Original tool result: parsed JSON when the text is JSON, otherwise the text or multiple MCP content blocks. Provider fields depend on the selected query.

title: ga4 query audience export
